title: Scotcheroos
ingredients: 6 cups Rice Krispies cereal (or other cereal of choice)

For topping:
1 ½ cup butterscotch chips
instructions: Measure the Rice Krispies and set aside.
In a large pot, heat the sugar and corn syrup on medium-low heat until the sugar dissolves. Don't bring the mixture to a full boil; small slow bubbles are okay.
Once the sugar dissolves, take off heat or change to low temp and add the peanut butter and vanilla.  The mixture should look smooth and creamy, not dry and crumbly.
Pour the cereal mixture into the pan and lightly pack.
Heat both types of chips either by microwave or on the stove until completely melted.
story: Scotcheroos is a dessert that reminds me of my grandmother. She would always bring this dessert to family gatherings. My siblings and I would always look forward to her scotcheroos and cherry cheesecake delight!
